'''''Larty Three-Niner''''' was an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] that participated in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]. During the battle the gunship was called for by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to evac the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]]. The gunship was, however, destroyed by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] soon after landing. All hands were lost.
